1701010.office: Village of Alsip, Term Limits. Shall the Village of Alsip modify its current term limits so that no person shall be eligible to seek election to, or hold the office of Village President (Mayor), Village Clerk, or Village Trustee if that person has already served four (4) consecutive four-year terms in that specific office, rather than the current limit of three (3) consecutive four-year terms?

1705404.office: Village of Berkeley, Issue Bonds. This is an advisory and non-binding referendum question. Should the Village of Berkeley, Cook County, Illinois issue bonds on behalf of the Berkeley Public Library in the amount of $4,000,000 to renovate, repair and equip the library building located at 1637 N. Taft Avenue?

1708576.office: Village of Brookfield, Increase Limiting Rate. Shall the limiting rate under the Property Tax Extension Limitation Law for the Village of Brookfield, Cook County, Illinois, be increased by an additional amount equal to 0.3711% above the limiting rate for municipal corporate purposes for levy year 2024 and be equal to 2.2764% of the equalized assessed value of the taxable property therein for levy year 2026? (1) The approximate amount of taxes extendable at the most recently extended limiting rate is $10,267,149, and the approximate amount of taxes extendable if the proposition is approved is $12,267,149. (2) For the 2026 levy year the approximate amount of the additional tax extendable against property containing a single family residence and having a fair market value at the time of the referendum of $100,000 is estimated to be $112.45. (3) If the proposition is approved, the aggregate extension for 2026 will be determined by the limiting rate set forth in the proposition, rather than the otherwise applicable limiting rate calculated under the provisions of the Property Tax Extension Limitation Law (commonly known as the Property Tax Cap Law).

1710513.office: Village of Calumet Park, Waive Building Permit Fees for Veterans. Shall the Village of Calumet Park, Cook County, Illinois, waive home building permit fees for Veterans?

Village of Calumet Park, Term Limits. Shall the terms of office for the offices of Village President (Mayor), Village Clerk, and Village Trustee in the Village of Calumet Park be subject to new term limits prospectively so that no person may seek election to, or hold, the same office for more than three (3) consecutive, full, four (4) year terms?
Village of Calumet Park, Waive Transfer Stamp Fees for Veterans. Shall the Village of Calumet Park, Cook County, Illinois, waive exempt transfer stamp fees of $50.00 for Veterans?

1717497.office: Village of Crestwood, Reduced Vehicle Stickers for Seniors. Shall the Village of Crestwood, Cook County, Illinois, reduce the yearly cost of passenger vehicle Village stickers for Senior Citizens over the age of 60 to five dollars ($5.00)?

Village of Crestwood, Reduced Vehicle Stickers for Veterans. Shall the Village of Crestwood, Cook County, Illinois, reduce the yearly cost of passenger vehicle Village stickers for Veterans, one per person, to zero dollars ($0.00)?

Village of Crestwood, Term Limits. Shall the current term limits for the Village of Crestwood be amended so that elected officers of the Village of Crestwood may serve in the same office for no more than three (3) full four-year terms, beginning at the next municipal election in the Village of Crestwood?

1727702.office: Village of Franklin Park, Planting of Fruit Trees. Shall the Village of Franklin Park, Cook County, Illinois, prohibit the planting of fruit bearing trees on private property as part of the Village’s Rodent Abatement Program?

Village of Franklin Park, Enforcement of Parking Regulations. Shall the Village of Franklin Park, Cook County, Illinois, strengthen the enforcement of parking regulations to improve public safety and emergency vehicle access?

Village of Franklin Park, Decrease Speed Limit on Franklin Ave. Shall the Village of Franklin Park, Cook County, Illinois, decrease the speed limit on Franklin Avenue from Ruby Street to Edgington Street from 25 miles per hour to 20 miles per hour to improve pedestrian safety?

1747007.office: City of Markham, Adopt Managerial Form of Government. Shall the City of Markham, Cook County, Illinois, adopt the managerial form of municipal government?
City of Markham, Should the City Operate Parks and Recreation. Shall the City of Markham, Cook County, Illinois, operate and maintain the Parks and Recreation services for the people of Markham?

City of Markham, Term Limits. Shall term limits for the City of Markham elected officers be established so that no elected official serve in the same office for more than two (2) full four-year terms, beginning at the next municipal election in the City of Markham?

1753000.office: Village of Niles, Discontinue Vehicle Sticker Program. At the May 25, 2026 Regular Board of Trustees Meeting, Mayor George D. Alpogianis and the Board of Trustees announced their intention to end the residential vehicle sticker program. Shall the Village of Niles discontinue the requirement that residents purchase and display municipal vehicle stickers and eliminate the associated vehicle sticker fee effective June 1, 2027?
Village of Niles, Indoor-Outdoor Theater. Shall the Village consider attracting an indoor/outdoor theatre within the Village limits?

Village of Niles, Term Limits. Shall the Village of Niles, pursuant to State law, including Section 3.1-10-17 of the Illinois Municipal Code, establish a sixteen (16) year term limit for the office of Village Trustee, superseding all prior conflicting ordinances and referenda, and providing that, prospectively from the effective date of such term limit, no person may serve as a Village Trustee for more than sixteen (16) years in the aggregate, whether by election or appointment, except that a Trustee who reaches sixteen (16) years of service during a term may complete that term but shall thereafter be ineligible to serve as Village Trustee?

1754885.office: Village of Oak Park, Investment in Israel. Should the State of Illinois repeal laws that ban state investment in businesses that boycott the State of Israel?
